name: Gauto Airlines
blurb: A budget-friendly South African airline linking Johannesburg with domestic cities and destinations across Africa and Europe.

about: Gauto is a budget-friendly South African airline with service originating from Johannesburg. It combines an extensive domestic network with international flights across Africa and into Europe.
network: Popular services from Johannesburg include Cape Town, London Gatwick, Paris Orly, Durban, Gqeberha, Douala, Harare, Windhoek and Libreville.
